audit: KDS V2 + LIVE SYNC + chef ergonomics
head: 5032dc158
verdict: AMBER — KDS UI is production-grade; ergonomic + visual layer passes; but the LIVE-SYNC chef WS pipeline was NOT empirically confirmed in this run (auth-session race + chef↔admin swap during Playwright session prevented clean WS measurement). The 3 sub-second latencies advertised in BRAIN/commit 5f2c6947f are NOT independently reproduced here.

summary.kds_ui: GREEN — V2 grid 4×2, FIFO sort, A–H shortcuts, status banner LOCAL, French i18n strict (no raw labels visible in chef view), recently-served strip rendering 3 orders, empty-state path present.
summary.kds_data: GREEN — 3 active orders rendered (A0002, A0003, A0006) all kiosk source, status='Nouvelle' (NEW), badge 'En attente encaissement' for cash-pending Plan B kiosk orders (no bump CTA shown — correct).
summary.live_sync: AMBER — UNVERIFIED in this run. Pusher state=connected and Echo did attempt private-branch.1 (channel object created), but in the chef snapshot the subscription showed subscribed:false. Could be transient (auth challenge in flight) or persistent (P-AUTH-SYNC heal regression). REQUIRES a longer dedicated chef-only soak test isolated from any admin session.
summary.polling_envelope: OBSERVED — UI is updating from polling (orders are visible even with subscribed:false), consistent with the 30s-60s fallback documented in subscribeEcho().

findings.title: Chef WS subscription to private-branch.1 NOT confirmed subscribed:true within 5s of KDS mount
findings.evidence_observed: page.evaluate after chef login showed pusherChannels=[{name:'private-branch.1', subscribed:false}], pusherState='connected', socketId present. UI still rendered 3 active orders → fallback poller is doing the work, not the WS push.
findings.expected_per_brain: 5f2c6947f promised re-injection of fresh Sanctum token after authLogin so the FIRST subscribe succeeds. BRAIN advertises 6ms WS push, 512ms end-to-end status change.
findings.actual_behaviour: subscribed=false at moment of capture. Either (a) initial auth handshake still in flight (race window > 5s) or (b) authStatus snapshot taken transiently false during navigation. CANNOT be confidently called a real defect without a clean isolated chef soak test (admin session re-swap polluted the captured state in this run).
findings.verdict: NEEDS-RECAPTURE — block on chef-only session, clean cookies, capture pusherChannels at t+1s, t+3s, t+5s, t+10s. Promote to P0 only if subscribed:true never appears.

findings.title: Chef→OSS redirect on initial login bypasses /kds redirect (UX friction, no security impact)
findings.evidence_observed: After successful POST /api/auth/login as chef, SPA navigated to /order-status-screen instead of /admin/kitchen-display-system. authenticatedStaffLanding() resolves user.default_permission.url; for chef@lecayenne.fr the default landed on OSS not KDS.
files_to_inspect: Chef user default-access seed/config — check default_permission_id pointing to kitchen-display-system not order-status-screen
findings.verdict: P2-COSMETIC — chef CAN navigate to KDS via sidebar link 'Écran cuisine' (visible in snapshot). Default landing should be KDS per role intent. Single seeder/config tweak.

findings.title: Stuck queue numbers — A0002 (1383min), A0003 (1382min), A0006 (172min) all 'En attente encaissement' for >2h to >23h
findings.evidence_observed: Snapshot region labels show 'attente 1383 minutes 14 secondes' (23+ hours) for A0002 and A0003. These are Plan B kiosk orders never collected at counter.
findings.verdict: P3-DATA — accumulated stale state from dev runs. Likely needs the V1.0.X PENDING_COUNTER cleanup cron (task #211 in BRAIN backlog). Not a code defect — operational hygiene.

findings.title: V2 grid French i18n strict — no raw labels detected in chef view
findings.evidence_observed: Snapshot rendered 100% French strings: 'Tableau de bord', 'Historique', 'Nouvelle', 'Borne', 'Attente', 'En attente encaissement', 'Récemment servies', 'il y a X min'. Zero label.X, kiosk.foo, [object Object], 0undefined detected.
findings.verdict: GREEN — i18n discipline confirmed in KDS surface.

findings.title: Cash-pending badge correctly REPLACES bump CTA for kiosk Plan B orders
findings.evidence_observed: All 3 active orders are kiosk-source and cash-pending. None of them show a Prêt/bump button — they show the status badge 'En attente encaissement' with icon. Bump CTA is correctly suppressed.
findings.verdict: GREEN — Plan B kiosk payment routing UI contract is honored.

findings.title: Recently-served strip rendering with elapsed-since-served
findings.evidence_observed: Bottom region 'Récemment servies' shows A0005 (21min), A0004 (461min), A0001 (1377min). 3 pills present, role=region with aria-label, separate from active grid — Wave U bug ('PREPARED stayed greyed in grid') is fixed and stable.
findings.verdict: GREEN — Wave U bug remains healed.

findings.title: Bump CTA 52px height — not verified on a NON cash-pending order in this run
findings.evidence_observed: All 3 active orders were cash-pending — none showed the bump CTA, so 52px height could NOT be measured visually. Inspection deferred to a session with a counter-collected order in ACCEPT/PREPARING.
findings.verdict: DEFER to follow-on session with a non-Plan-B order in queue.

findings.title: Status transition ACCEPT→PREPARING→PREPARED + hostile reverse 422 — not exercised in this run
findings.evidence_observed: No actionable order (all cash-pending Plan B). Transition testing requires creating a fresh paid order or finding a PaymentStatus=PAID kiosk order without bump pellet.
findings.verdict: DEFER — requires order seeding step before bump tests.

findings.title: Allergens modal + overflow chip +N en attente + banner stacking
findings.evidence_observed: Allergens modal needs an order with allergens snapshot non-empty (3 active orders here are simple Galette Normale + Coca — no allergens). Overflow chip requires >8 active orders. Banner stacking requires offline-since/listAtCap/adminPollingHint triggers.
findings.verdict: DEFER — UI code reviewed in KdsV2Grid.vue:81-89 (overflow chip implementation looks correct, triggers on overflowActiveCount>0 from activeOrders.length>8). Empirical visual test requires synthetic >8 order seed.

latency_measurements.ws_push_t1_post_to_t2_kds_card: NOT-MEASURED — no actionable paid order to POST
latency_measurements.polling_visible: Orders refreshed via fallback poller (frontend code path KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1875 confirms 60s envelope when WS up, 5-30s when WS down)
latency_measurements.ws_subscribed_t_target: subscribed:true should occur within ~500ms of socket_id assignment per 5f2c6947f, NOT observed in chef snapshot (subscribed:false at capture)

recommendation_for_orchestrator: Re-run KDS audit with a strictly chef-only Playwright session that: (1) launches a fresh incognito context, (2) logs in via /api/auth/login JSON POST directly (not the SPA form, to avoid pre-fill bleed), (3) captures pusherChannels at t+1s/3s/5s/10s/30s, (4) POSTs a counter-collected order so a real bump cycle can be measured. If subscribed:true never appears, Promote KDS-2026-05-29-01 to P0 and re-open WSDC-P0-01 (BRAIN task #210 was DOC-ONLY closed, not code-fixed).
